title: Exchange Online Basic authentication permanent disablement rollout begins
summary: Microsoft began permanently disabling Basic authentication in Exchange Online tenants from October 1, 2022 for the affected protocols, with later phased completion across tenants and environments.
migration_path: Update affected Exchange Online clients and applications to Modern authentication/OAuth 2.0 or supported newer interfaces.
user_impact: Applications that depended on username/password Basic authentication for affected Exchange Online protocols must change authentication or stop working.
notes: October 1, 2022 is the documented main disablement boundary, not an inferred universal final-completion date.
